description: This file implements a SelectorEvaluator class for evaluating CSS selectors and related utilities within a web automation context, including caching, engine management, and DOM querying.

classes.name: SelectorEvaluatorImpl
classes.description: Implements the SelectorEvaluator interface, managing selector engines, caching, and DOM querying logic.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if an element matches a given selector within a specific context.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Finds all elements matching a selector within a given context.

methods.name: _markScore
methods.description: Temporarily marks an element with a score for sorting purposes.

methods.name: _hasScopeClause
methods.description: Determines if a selector includes a scope clause.

methods.name: _expandContextForScopeMatching
methods.description: Expands the query context to include scope matching via parent or shadow host.

methods.name: _matchesSimple
methods.description: Checks if an element matches a simple selector.

methods.name: _querySimple
methods.description: Queries elements matching a simple selector.

methods.name: _matchesParents
methods.description: Checks if an element matches the parent chain of a complex selector.

methods.name: _matchesEngine
methods.description: Evaluates if an element matches a selector engine with given arguments.

methods.name: _queryEngine
methods.description: Queries elements using a specific selector engine.

methods.name: _callMatches
methods.description: Calls the 'matches' method of a selector engine with caching.

methods.name: _callQuery
methods.description: Calls the 'query' method of a selector engine with caching.

methods.name: _matchesCSS
methods.description: Checks if an element matches a CSS selector string.

methods.name: _queryCSS
methods.description: Queries elements matching a CSS selector string, with caching and shadow piercing.

methods.name: _getEngine
methods.description: Retrieves a selector engine by name, throws if unknown.
